headline: Capital Small Finance Bank reports 23% rise in advances and 16% growth in deposits for Q2
hook: Loan book growth beats sequential quarters
summary: Capital Small Finance Bank announced its Q2 operational update, reporting a 23.4% year-on-year rise in gross advances to ₹9,755 crore. Deposits grew 16% to ₹14,242 crore compared to the same period last year. The bank's disbursements surged 36% sequentially to ₹1,095 crore, with 97% of the loan book remaining secured. Retail investors tracking small finance banks can evaluate these metrics for underlying credit demand and asset quality trends.
why_it_matters: Strong credit growth signals healthy loan demand for the bank.

headline: Capital Small Finance Bank schedules committee meeting for October 6, 2026
hook: Board meeting scheduled for early October
summary: Capital Small Finance Bank has notified the stock exchanges that a committee meeting is scheduled to take place on October 6, 2026. The company did not disclose the specific agenda items to be discussed at the meeting in this initial filing. Such procedural disclosures are routine regulatory requirements for listed entities. Indian retail investors should note this is a standard administrative update with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative meeting with no direct portfolio impact.
